WHAT: The National Endowment for the Arts will present a free tribute concert in honor of the 2026 Jazz Masters on Tuesday, September 15, 2026, at 8:00 p.m. PT at The Music Center's Walt Disney Concert Hall in Los Angeles, California, and streamed online. The National Endowment for the Arts Jazz Masters Fellowship is the nation’s highest honor in jazz.

results.content: AUSTIN – Austin Water will conduct a test of the floodgate warning sirens at Longhorn Dam on Tuesday, September 15, 2026, at 10 a.m. Residents and visitors in the surrounding area may hear the siren during the test. No emergency is occurring and no action is required from the public. The siren test will sound, one time, continuously for five minutes.

> Beginning September 15, 2026, U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) will require new editions of Form I-765, Application for Employment Authorization, and Form I-539, Application to Extend/Change Nonimmigrant Status. There will be no grace period for the older editions.
>
> This is an important filing change for anyone who is currently preparing one of these applications because using the wrong edition could result in USCIS rejecting the filing.
